title: Rivalry
paragraphs: “Wow… She hates him so much that she had to add even more at the end…”
“If I had to choose between marrying the Whip Hero or a dragon, I would much rather marry the dragon.”
“You hate him that much!?”
“Well, I can understand, but… that’s intense. Just how much did she hate him…?”
“Maybe Takt’s sister realized how much Melty despised him.”

She really does hate him with no bottom in sight. From my experience, even Takt must have figured out by now which people he simply cannot win over. There are certainly people even I could never win over.
Like the older sister! But I will dedicate my entire life to winning over Filo-tan. Even if no path exists, I will break through fate itself and devote myself to Filo-tan.
“I’ll compete by finding all the things I hate about Takt too!”
“Why are you doing something so ridiculous!?”
“First, he’s reckless. Next, he’s arrogant. And then, he’s foolish!”
“Those are all the same thing!”
Itsuki is being noisy!
“He loves pigs! He lives driven by his lower body! He thinks any pig will do! He was probably convinced he could win over Fiancée too!”
“Look at your own face and actions before you talk!”
Even Ren scolded me. How noisy.
I can’t afford to lose to Fiancée!
“He raises dragons! He’s probably raising slaves too! He’s probably managing territory as well!”
“That applies to me in the first world too. Are you sure you’re okay with that?”
…That was a mistake. This must be a lesson to be careful with my words.
“I take that back.”
“You don’t have to force a correction. Just let me continue the discussion!”
“I understand. But let me add just a few more things.”
“You’re still going!?”
Then, I shall continue. There are endless reasons why I hate Takt.
“He made Father sad in the first world. He slaughtered many noble Filolials. In past loops, he has pointed a gun at us countless times. He used the Dragon Emperor to throw the world into chaos.”
Well, that about sums it up.
“What were we even talking about again…?”
“How to deal with Melromarc’s rampage.”
“How about we just wipe them out along with their army using the power of the heroes?”
If Father gave the order, I, Motoyasu, could do it alone. Just like before, I’ll burn the entire enemy army to ashes. As I showed my enthusiasm, Father and the others looked at me with exasperation.
“Kitamura-dono, the queen’s goal is to minimize casualties as much as possible. Please hold back.”
“But isn’t that necessary to bring this situation under control?”
“Hmm…”
Father and the others groaned.

Is this really such a difficult problem? Recalling the events of the first world, a significant number of soldiers were captured when Father’s innocence was proven. If they’re going to be punished anyway, it shouldn’t matter who does it.
“There’s also the emotions of the citizens to consider.”
“If we ultimately resolve it with brute force, we might just repeat the same mistakes…”
“Yes. But that doesn’t mean there are no solutions. Though, in the end, resolving it with power isn’t all that different.”
The queen murmured in response.
So, doesn’t that mean my conclusion was correct?
“And what kind of solution is that?”
“This time, the ones who caused the problem were the impostor who posed as my husband and the Three Heroes Church. We believe the emotions of the citizens are not as involved in this matter.”
“So, basically, like Motoyasu said, it’s just the country’s leadership running wild, and we just need to take out the head?”
“Won’t another head just grow back right away?”
…? What? I have no idea what the queen is trying to say. However, when Father realized it and answered, the queen nodded.
“I see. So, we just have to take back control before a new head can form.”
“Naofumi-san, what do you mean?”
“Motoyasu, you’ve probably known people like this before—those rich guys who cut off the head of a corrupt company and then take over themselves.”
“There was one, yes. But what does that have to do with this?”

There was a pig who, at first glance, seemed to have turned a failing company around. At the time, I accepted it, but I don’t really know what happened afterward. Well, I don’t care about some pig’s company anyway.
“This is also a rather forceful method, but if we purge the corrupt officials now and have the queen return, things might work out.”
“That sounds exactly like the kind of situation Motoyasu would love. Are you okay with this?”
“Well, there’s no way they’d allow me to take the same approach Motoyasu keeps bringing up—converting the citizens and changing the country from the ground up.”
Oh, that’s right. Father did mention it before. That if he stayed in Melromarc, he wouldn’t be able to move freely.
“This time, it’s the opposite. If the problem started because Motoyasu took down that king, then restoring the head the same way—having the queen return—should fix it.”
“But isn’t this still enemy territory? Will it really work?”

“We’re dealing with the Three Heroes Church, remember? It’s a religion that worships all of the Four Holy Heroes except the Shield Hero. If Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu show their godlike strength while exposing the corruption of the Three Heroes Church—excluding me, of course—the message will spread.”
“For example?”

“Let’s see… Yeah. We could claim that one of the causes of the Waves is actually the Three Heroes Church! We’d declare that their current actions can’t be tolerated even by divine standards, and if we demonstrate our strength, the citizens will see the corruption for what it is. Eventually, the Three Heroes Church will be forced to reform.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded at Father’s words. It seems they finally understood. I still don’t really get it, though.
“The Four Holy Heroes hold considerable power. But won’t the factions being expelled resist?”
“Of course, they’ll resist. That’s why it’ll probably turn into a forceful scenario where we ‘dispose’ of them in the name of God.”
“That sounds like a violent strategy.”

“If we don’t do that, Melromarc will just start another war. We retaliate for what was done to us and punish those responsible. For a while, our mission will be to protect the queen and Melty, I suppose?”
“There are probably other ways to handle this.”

“Yeah, but considering Imia-chan’s case, demi-human persecution is accelerating, and war is imminent. If we waste time trying roundabout solutions, the human citizens could end up with massive casualties too.”
I think Father made his decision rather quickly. Well, the current state of demi-human persecution is atrocious. If there’s a way to resolve it, the sooner, the better.

“There must be more girls like Imia-chan out there. The people torturing demi-humans aren’t just ten or twenty individuals. It may be forcing our sense of justice on them, but I refuse to let such a situation be considered ‘right.’”
“I see… Last time, I heard that Éclair was tortured and died in prison because of Naofumi’s actions. So to minimize victims, we take a more forceful approach?”

“Yeah, we can worry about cleanup later. Once we have the time, we can work through Melromarc’s problems one by one. After gaining the people’s trust, if Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu declare that the Three Heroes Church is evil, that alone should settle everything in an instant.”

The word of God is absolute. Before letting them act under the idea that an inconvenient god is no god at all, we first build up tangible results. In the first world and the last loop, Father, the Shield Hero, was the one improving the citizens’ lives.

Now, what happens if Ren, Itsuki, and I take the lead instead? Of course, if we act recklessly like in the first world, it’ll just be selfishness. But if we genuinely help people, the citizens will come to blindly follow us. To establish that foundation, our first goal must be to silence the top leaders of the Three Heroes Church, which is the biggest immediate problem.
“I understand Naofumi-san’s plan. First, we extract as much of the rot as possible, then treat the wound.”
“So, like waiting for the swelling to go down before treating a cavity?”

“I’m not sure about that phrasing, but yeah. The Three Heroes Church will definitely resist, but the first priority is normalizing diplomatic relations. The people of this world don’t have time for war.”
“I heard that Father’s impostors have been causing trouble all over. People pretending to be heroes, it seems.”
How do we deal with that issue? Those guys will stop at nothing.

“It’s a serious crime, but I suppose it’s not surprising. Even if impostors show up, it won’t be a problem. Because… Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu are the real ones, and unlike in the first world or the last loop, they’re not acting selfishly. So what happens if someone pretending to be a hero starts causing trouble now?”
“They can pretend to be Naofumi, but they can’t pretend to be us. That’s a solid strategy.”
“Doing good deeds later to prevent them from being treated as impostors… That makes sense.”

“Then… the plan is more or less set. First, we eliminate the current leadership again to make it easier to act and bring back the queen. After that, resolving Melromarc’s issues is the best course of action.”
“From what I’ve heard of Motoyasu-san’s stories before, that means dealing with the food supply problem and infrastructure improvements.”
These are essential factors for daily life. Not just in Melromarc, but also in the surrounding countries—honestly, even in Faubrey.
